meta.name: design-taste-frontend
meta.description: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. The agent reads the brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为落地页和作品集生成不套模板的前端界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果厌倦了模板化设计，想要有品味的定制前端界面。
copy.tagline_en: Ship non-templated frontend interfaces for landing pages and portfolios.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are tired of templated designs and want tasteful custom frontend interfaces.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 做落地页、作品集或改版时会先读需求、推演出设计方向再动手,产出不像通用模板的界面;改版先做审查,交付前跑一遍硬性检查。
howto.when: 当你要做落地页、作品集或网站改版时触发;需求含糊且设计方向分歧明显时,它只问一个问题。

say.text: 帮我做一个 SaaS 落地页,先读需求再定设计方向
say.note: 它会先给出一句 Design Read 再写代码

say.text: 把我的作品集重做一版,先审查现有页面
say.note: 改版走审查优先的流程

say.text: 这个面向公众的服务页面,按信任优先来做

howto.what_en: Claude reads your brief and infers a design direction before writing code, so landing pages, portfolios and redesigns don't look templated. Redesigns start with an audit; a pre-flight check runs before delivery.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a landing page, a portfolio, or a site redesign; if the brief is ambiguous and the direction genuinely diverges, it asks one question.

say_en.text: Build me a SaaS landing page; read the brief first, then pick a direction
say_en.note: It states a one-line Design Read before coding

say_en.text: Redesign my portfolio; audit the existing pages first
This public-sector page should feel trust-first
say_en.note: It reaches for GOV.UK Frontend or USWDS
